name: Seachem Flourish Nitrogen
description: Liquid nitrogen supplement (blend of nitrate and ammonium-derived nitrogen). Seachem does not publish a per-dose ppm, so values are NOT disclosed — qualitative `affects` only.
notes: Label dose ~5 ml per 250 L twice weekly. Contains some ammonium-N — dose conservatively in lightly-stocked tanks to avoid feeding algae.
